{'text': 'Last week, Apple sued OpenAI, claiming a former employee "stole trade secrets for OpenAI\'s benefit."', 'translation': '上週，Apple對OpenAI提起訴訟，聲稱其前員工「為了OpenAI的利益」竊取了商業機密。'}

{'text': 'As part of the litigation, Apple has reportedly sent letters directly to dozens of former employees who now work at OpenAI.', 'translation': '在訴訟過程中，據報Apple已直接向數十名現於OpenAI工作的前員工發出信函。'}

{'text': 'According to the Financial Times, Apple has issued litigation hold notices to roughly 40 former employees.', 'translation': '據《金融時報》報導，Apple已向約40名前員工發出證據保存函。'}

{'text': 'A litigation hold notice is a formal written notice sent to an individual or organization requiring them to preserve documents, records, and other evidence that may be relevant to a legal dispute. These letters typically specify what exactly must be preserved.', 'translation': '證據保存函是一種正式書面通知，發給個人或機構，要求其保存可能與法律糾紛相關的文件、紀錄及其他證據。這類信函通常會列明須保存的具體內容。'}

{'text': "Apple suspects that the trade secret theft may have extended beyond what was initially named in last week's lawsuit, prompting the move.", 'translation': 'Apple懷疑商業機密竊取行為可能不止於上週初步訴訟中所點名的範圍，故此採取上述行動。'}

{'text': "In case you missed it: Apple's lawsuit names OpenAI and io Products as defendants, as well as former Apple employees Chang Liu and Tang Tan.", 'translation': '溫故知新：Apple的訴訟將OpenAI及io Products列為被告，同時還有前Apple員工Chang Liu及Tang Tan。'}

{'text': "You can read more about Apple's lawsuit against OpenAI here:", 'translation': '你可在此了解更多有關Apple控告OpenAI的詳情：'}

  • {'text': 'Apple Sues OpenAI, Accusing Former Employee of Stealing Trade Secrets', 'translation': 'Apple起訴OpenAI，指控前員工竊取商業機密'}
  • {'text': "An Email Mishap Derailed Apple's Settlement Talks With OpenAI Before the Lawsuit", 'translation': '一封電郵失誤令Apple與OpenAI的訴訟前談判脫軌'}
  • {'text': "Apple's Lawsuit Reveals How Many Former Employees It Has Working at OpenAI", 'translation': 'Apple訴訟揭示其現有多少名前員工在OpenAI任職'}
  • {'text': "OpenAI Says It Has Seen No Evidence to Support Apple's Trade Secret Theft Claims", 'translation': 'OpenAI表示未見任何證據支持Apple的商業機密竊取指控'}
  • {'text': "OpenAI's Hardware Development Timeline Remains Unchanged After Apple Lawsuit", 'translation': 'Apple訴訟後，OpenAI硬件發展時間表維持不變'}

{'text': "You can read the full text of Apple's initial lawsuit filing here.", 'translation': '你可在此閱讀Apple初步訴訟文件的全文。'}

{'text': 'My favorite iPhone accessories:', 'translation': '我最喜愛的iPhone配件：'}

  • {'text': 'Anker Nano USB-C wall charger with built-in screen', 'translation': '內置屏幕的Anker Nano USB-C牆插充電器'}
  • {'text': 'AirPods Pro 3: see current deals', 'translation': 'AirPods Pro 3：查看目前優惠價'}
  • {'text': 'Charge all your Apple devices at once', 'translation': '同時為你所有Apple裝置充電'}
  • {'text': 'Bring wireless CarPlay to any car', 'translation': '將無線CarPlay帶到任何汽車'}
  • {'text': 'USB-C cable that shows charging speed', 'translation': '顯示充電速度的USB-C線'}

{'text': 'Follow Chance: Threads, Bluesky, Instagram, and Mastodon.', 'translation': '追蹤Chance：Threads、Bluesky、Instagram及Mastodon。'}
